999008199.text: まいどありー！
結構な大荷物になってしまいましたね

localizations.en: We ended up with quite a lot of luggage, didn't we?

999008199.text:
こういう時は助けを求めるのさ！
やあやあ、そこの君！

localizations.en: Times like this, you gotta ask for help! Hey there, you!

999008199.text: あん？
あれ？　マクダじゃん

お、ミーケ、相変わらずかわいいな……って！
クリセルダ！　なんでお前がここに！

localizations.en: Oh, Mieke! Still cute as ever... Wait! Criselda! What the hell are you doing here?!

999008199.text:
脱獄したわけじゃないわよ？
仮釈放の身になったの。色々と貢献したからね

localizations.en: I didn't break out of prison, if that's what you're thinking. I'm on parole now—made quite a few contributions, you see.

999008199.text:
格好も自由すぎだろ。
いいのかよこんな奴外に出して

localizations.en: That outfit's way too casual for a prisoner. Is it really okay to let someone like you walk free?

999008199.text: 大丈夫大丈夫、クリセルダは結構大丈夫

localizations.en: It's fine, it's fine! Criselda's pretty okay.

999008199.text: ええ、その通りよ。私、結構大丈夫

localizations.en: Exactly right. I'm quite okay indeed.

999008199.text: 信用ならねえ……ぜってえなんか企んでる顔してる

localizations.en: I don't trust it... You've definitely got that scheming look in your eyes.

999008199.text:
気のせいだと思いますけど……。
ところで、マクダにお願いがあるんです

localizations.en: I think you're imagining things... By the way, we have a favor to ask of you, Magda.

999008199.text:
ああ、そうなのか？
そういやなんで声をかけたんだ？

localizations.en: Oh yeah? So that's why you called out to me?

999008199.text:
海まで荷物を運ぶのを手伝ってくれる方を
探しているんです

localizations.en: We're looking for someone to help us carry our luggage to the beach.

999008199.text:
なるほどな……。
いいぜ、星の繭の飯をおごってくれるんならよ

localizations.en: I see... Sure thing, as long as you treat me to a meal at Star's Cocoon.

999008199.text: 本当？　それだけでいいの？

ああ。ちょうどマクダ様もグランプリとやらを
見ようと思ってたんだ

localizations.en: Yeah. I was thinking about checking out this Grand Prix thing anyway.

999008199.text:
では決まりね。
星の繭で腹ごしらえをしたら、出発しましょう

localizations.en: Then it's settled. Once we grab a bite at Star's Cocoon, we'll head out.

999008199.text: ということでミーケ。支払いはよろしくお願いね

localizations.en: So Mieke, I'm counting on you to handle the bill.

999008199.text:
え！？　ミーケが！？
こういう時は一番偉い人が払うものじゃん！

localizations.en: What?! Me?! Isn't the person with the highest rank supposed to pay at times like this?!

999008199.text:
そうしたいのは山々だけど、
牢から出たばかりでそんなお金ないもの、今度おごるわ

localizations.en: I'd love to, but I just got out of prison—I don't have that kind of money. I'll treat you next time.

999008199.text: そうだったー！　とほほ……
